pageProps.title: Too Loud a Solitude
pageProps.review: Through Bohumil Hrabal's novel 'Too Loud a Solitude', I empathized with the protagonist's deep solitude, reflected on the emotions of modern people living in the AI era, and recommend it as a life book I want to read again.
pageProps.description: For thirty-five years, I have been pressing books and wastepaper, becoming saturated with type, and I have become much like the books I have pressed with my own hands.
pageProps.content:
## Review To be honest, I read through the beginning of the book without fully understanding the content. But gradually, I began to feel the protagonist's solitude. I love the title of the book. It clearly reflects what the book is trying to convey.
It's a book that reminds me of ```No Country for Old Men```.
With the arrival of the AI era, I am also feeling similar emotions.
A recommended book for me that I'd like to read again if I get the chance.
